Step-Up SIP: ₹1.86 crore vs ₹92 lakh 📈 | Power of Compounding

Start with ₹10,000/month for 20 years.
Flat SIP: ₹24 lakh invested → ₹92 lakh
Increase it 10% every year: ₹68.7 lakh invested → ₹1.86 crore

Raise your SIP when your salary rises. It rarely feels like a sacrifice, and it can transform the result.
